about.title: About the Ascended Heroes set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Ascended Heroes is a Mega Evolution expansion released on 30 January 2026. It has 295 cards: 217 in the main set and 78 secret rares. For a master set there are also 318 reverse holos, Poké Ball holos, Friend Ball holos, Love Ball holos, Quick Ball holos, Dusk Ball holos, Team Rocket holos and Energy Symbol holos, and 16 special prints from other products and events.

Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 217 main set cards), the Complete set (all 295 cards), the Master set (613 cards, adding every reverse holos, Poké Ball holos, Friend Ball holos, Love Ball holos, Quick Ball holos, Dusk Ball holos, Team Rocket holos and Energy Symbol holos) or the Grand Master set (629 cards, adding the 16 special prints (stamped, Cosmos Holo and other product-exclusive cards)).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
